text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- Zagrebacka Banka starts receiving requests for housing loans. The largest sum available is 250,000 German marks, to be repaid during a 15-year period at a variable interest rate of 9.0 percent.
- The registration of political parties for the elections in Eastern Slavonia to commence at the beginning of february.

- Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) to capture 43 percent of the vote, Croatian Social-Liberal Party 19 and Croatian Peasant's Party 18 percent of the vote, according to a recent USIA (United States Information Agency) poll.
- Zagreb to be awarded two radio frequencies for the upcoming run for broadcasting licences which local radio stations, including Radio 101, would be facing on January 15.

- Croatia is in search for a radioactive waste dumping site, since so far it has accumulated some 80 cubic meters of such material. Four locations have been proposed so far. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
